sourceNote: scripts/rehearse-ai-art-container.sh at branch feat/256-ai-art-enable commit 04f673a (the API is unchanged from main d004d7f); only the fake OpenAI server gained the unavailable (503) failure and FAKE_OPENAI_FAIL_COUNT

environment.apiImage: built from infra/lightsail/api.Dockerfile (node:22-bookworm-slim, Node v22.23.3), the same Dockerfile the showcase host builds; removed after the run
environment.postgres: existing local container masscom-sky-qa-pg (postgres:16.10-alpine); the script created its own database masscom_256_test and dropped it afterwards
environment.network: API, fake OpenAI server and driver share the PostgreSQL container network namespace (--network container:...), so the API reaches Postgres and AI_ART_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> on its own loopback
environment.key: clearly fake value (fake-rehearsal-key-not-a-real-openai-key); never sent anywhere but the local fake server
environment.apiSettings: NODE_ENV=production, read-only filesystem with /tmp tmpfs and no-new-privileges (as the showcase compose), AI_ART_STAFF_MAY_MANAGE=true (as the showcase compose); SHOWCASE_MODE is not set because it requires the database name masscom_showcase

command: bash scripts/rehearse-ai-art-container.sh (about 54 seconds including the cached image build)
costArithmetic: fake usage -> draft 120 text tokens x 5 + 272 output x 30 = 8,760 µUSD per image; final 100 text x 5 + 1,300 image x 8 + 3,000 output x 30 = 100,900 µUSD. One full flow = 4 x 8,760 + 100,900 = 135,940 µUSD, which ai_art_spend recorded exactly. Failed OpenAI calls (429/500/503/400) settle to 0.

PASS: startup log: enabled (key + loopback base URL), disabled (OPENAI_API_KEY is empty), disabled (invalid configuration) for a disallowed OpenAI address
draft round returns 4 drafts (stamp, sticker, watercolor, woodcut), each a distinct valid webp

choose -> final generation (FINAL_READY, valid webp, not one of the drafts) -> apply -> public /merchant-art/<sha256>.webp served without login (200 image/webp, immutable cache, bytes equal the final image, hash equals the sha256 in the URL)
customer catalog /merchants shows the applied artUrl and null after DELETE reset; the old public address is 404
access: no token 401, account without membership 403 MERCHANT_ACCESS_DENIED, no round for that account
monthly budget USD 0.05: first draft round ok, second round and the final refused with 503 AI_ART_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED without any OpenAI request
daily limit (2 draft rounds, 1 final): third round and second final refused with 429 AI_ART_DAILY_LIMIT and an integer Retry-After; quota shows 0 left

OpenAI 429 (rate_limit, Retry-After 1), 500 and 503 on the draft stage and on the final stage: exactly one retry, then success (fake answered the error once, the API client logged attempt 2 once and no attempt 3, ai_art_spend as for a normal run)

OpenAI 429, 500 and 503 that never stop: each of the 4 drafts is tried exactly twice (8 requests), no attempt 3, round FAILED with AI_ART_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, spend rows settle to 0; on the final stage 2 attempts, the four drafts and the choice are kept, the failed final counts against the daily finals
400 (moderation_blocked): 4 requests, no retry, AI_ART_MODERATION_BLOCKED, spend 0; 429 credit_balance_exhausted: 4 requests, no retry, AI_ART_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE
the key value appears in no API log and no fake-server log in any scenario

notRun: a real OpenAI key and any real OpenAI call: real image quality, real cost per call (the $0.04 draft and $0.18 final estimates are unmeasured), real latency (the fake answers in 200 ms; the real service takes 1-2 minutes), real 180 s timeout behaviour
the real showcase server: no deployment, no enable-ai-art.sh run against real Docker, no recreate of the live showcase-api (the script is covered by a fake docker in tests/ops/enable_ai_art_test.sh)
the showcase compose file itself and the showcase database name (the rehearsal uses its own container settings and database masscom_256_test)
customer-facing display of a real AI image on a phone (a phone flow with the fake server was recorded earlier in docs/evidence/ai-store-art-2026-09-30/)
reproduce: docker must be running with a local PostgreSQL container named masscom-sky-qa-pg (or set REHEARSAL_PG_CONTAINER); run bash scripts/rehearse-ai-art-container.sh from the repository root; REHEARSAL_SKIP_BUILD=1 REHEARSAL_IMAGE=<tag> reuses an image and REHEARSAL_RESULT_FILE=<path> also writes the tab-separated results.
